summary: Extensions make delegation typed, budgeted, reconstructable, and selectively independent.

items.text: Define a subtask contract schema with inputs, allowed tools and paths, authority, budget, acceptance checks, output type, evidence links, and explicit unknowns.
Use an independent verifier for high-risk outputs, varying model, retrieval source, or deterministic method to reduce correlated self-review.
Represent the delegation graph as durable process state with leased work claims, deadlines, cancellation, and typed terminal verdicts.
Adopt an orchestration budget that limits fan-out and permits a worker to request missing context rather than recursively spawning without bound.
